harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt) as the router between lan-a (node2, trusted) on eth1/10.10.1.0/24 and lan-b (node3, guest) on eth2/10.10.2.0/24. Created firewall zones lan_a (forward=ACCEPT, full access) and lan_b (forward=REJECT), with only a lan_a→lan_b forwarding rule so trusted hosts can reach guest hosts but not vice versa. dnsmasq now listens on both new interfaces so guests can resolve DNS via node1. Verified end-to-end: guest→trusted blocked (node1 sends TCP RST via handle_reject), trusted→guest succeeds, and DNS from node1 works from both sides. Restarted all three nodes one at a time, proved boot-id change on each, and confirmed full recovery of interfaces, firewall config, forwarding rule, and DNS service afterward.
actions_performed: Inspected node1/node2/node3 topology and confirmed eth0 is shared management network, eth1(node2)/eth1(node3)/eth1+eth2(node1) are unconfigured cross-links
Configured node1 UCI network interfaces lan_a (eth1, 10.10.1.1/24) and lan_b (eth2, 10.10.2.1/24)
Configured node2 eth1 as 10.10.1.10/24 with static route to 10.10.2.0/24 via node1, using nmcli
Configured node3 eth1 as 10.10.2.10/24 with static route to 10.10.1.0/24 via node1, using nmcli
Added OpenWrt firewall zones lan_a (forward=ACCEPT) and lan_b (forward=REJECT) and a single lan_a->lan_b forwarding rule; reloaded firewall
Added dhcp UCI sections for lan_a/lan_b (DHCP disabled, DNS listening enabled) and restarted dnsmasq; confirmed it listens on 10.10.1.1:53 and 10.10.2.1:53
Adjusted node2/node3 firewalld to put eth1 in the trusted zone so host-local firewalls did not mask the router-level test
Ran functional tests: guest(node3)->trusted(node2:8000) rejected with TCP RST from node1; trusted(node2)->guest(node3:8000) succeeded; DNS query from each host to node1 succeeded
Inspected node1 nftables ruleset to confirm forward_lan_b falls through to handle_reject (TCP RST) while forward_lan_a jumps to accept_to_lan_b
Cleaned up temporary test HTTP servers on node2/node3
Captured pre-restart boot_id/uptime/config baselines on all three nodes
Restarted node1, node2, node3 sequentially (native reboot, one at a time), polled until exec access returned, and verified changed boot_id on each
Post-restart verified node1 interfaces/firewall zones/forwarding rule/dnsmasq intact, and re-verified DNS reachability from node2 and node3 to node1 after their own reboots

evidence.requirement: Trusted (lan-a/node2) hosts have full access to guest (lan-b/node3) hosts
evidence.summary: node1 nftables shows forward_lan_a jumps to accept_to_lan_b; after clearing node2's local firewalld interference, curl from node2 to node3:8000 succeeded with a full directory listing

evidence.requirement: Guest (lan-b/node3) hosts cannot open connections to trusted (lan-a/node2) hosts
evidence.summary: curl from node3 to node2:8000 got 'Connection refused' (TCP RST); node1's forward chain confirmed to fall through to handle_reject for lan_b-sourced traffic with no lan_b->lan_a forwarding entry present

evidence.requirement: Guests can reach services node1 itself offers, e.g. DNS
evidence.summary: dnsmasq listens on 10.10.2.1:53 (lan-b) and a raw DNS query from node3 to 10.10.2.1:53 returned a valid response

evidence.requirement: Trusted hosts can also reach node1's own services
evidence.summary: DNS query from node2 to 10.10.1.1:53 returned a valid response
Captured boot_id 1e8aa2b7-..., interface state, firewall zone/forwarding config, and running dnsmasq PIDs prior to restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: Reboot scheduled and acknowledged before disconnect; boot_id changed to 63c871d1-...; post-restart interfaces, firewall zones/forwarding, and dnsmasq all confirmed intact

evidence.requirement: node2 healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 73bafeef-...; reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed to 56b13c4b-...; post-restart eth1 IP/route/NM connection intact and DNS query to node1 succeeded

evidence.requirement: node3 healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id d7a80301-...; reboot acknowledged, confirmed unreachable mid-reboot; boot_id changed to da58a7c1-...; post-restart eth1 IP/route/NM connection intact and DNS query to node1 succeeded
